stem.text: The graph shows how the concentration of components,1, 2, 3 and 4, of an enzyme-catalysed reaction changes with time.

stem.alt: Line graph of concentration against time, with the vertical axis labelled concentration and the horizontal axis labelled time. Four curves are labelled 1, 2, 3 and 4.

stem.text: Which row identifies the components of this reaction?

A.text: enzyme–substrate complex; unbound enzyme; product; substrate

B.text: enzyme–substrate complex; product; substrate; unbound enzyme

C.text: product; enzyme–substrate complex; unbound enzyme; substrate

D.text: product; unbound enzyme; substrate; enzyme–substrate complex
